selected_styles.name: Cel-Shaded Anime
selected_styles.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Style/medium: STRONGLY GRAPHIC FLAT CEL ANIME, a finished original 2D animation film still. This example must be immediately distinct from richly painted detailed anime. Use large interlocking FLAT COLOR SHAPES throughout BOTH people and the entire environment. Each outfit and face has one base color and ONE or TWO crisp shadow shapes; no soft modeling gradients. Elegant adult anime faces, expressive restrained eyes, bold hair clusters, clean contours and natural appealing poses. Simplify the station wall to smooth cream and sage planes, bench to broad brown bands, canopy to a few confident geometric beams, hills to three broad designed color masses, and ground to a single warm ivory plane with a simple flat cast shadow. The whole image is a carefully designed anime animation layout with cinematic framing and clear emotion. NO plaster grain, pavement cracks, individual foliage, detailed fabric, photographic reflections, painterly background brush texture or mottled light. Make simplification confident and beautiful, not crude or diagrammatic. Keep the two-person reunion and letter readable.

selected_styles.name: Feature 2D Animation
selected_styles.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Style/medium: Confident original TWO-DIMENSIONAL CARTOON feature-animation design, clearly different from anime. Build the adults from appealing bold rounded shapes: the woman has a slightly enlarged rounded head, small button-like nose, lively brows, broad simple eyes and a chunky designed curl silhouette; the elderly father has a round friendly face, broad nose, strong curved brows and sculpted-looking GRAPHIC hair shapes drawn in 2D. Use mature adult bodies with about five to six heads of height, not children or chibi characters. Simple expressive hands and broad coat/cardigan shapes with very few folds. Strong flowing ink contours and clean color fills with just one simple shape shadow. All station architecture, bench and hills are friendly stylized graphic 2D shapes, clean broad masses and gently exaggerated geometry, not realistically painted wood/plaster or tiny foliage. A high-end animated comedy-drama movie frame, expressive and elegant, with warm appealing characters. Absolutely no realistic material grain, lush anime background treatment, glossy CGI, gradient-modeled realistic skin or generic flat stock clipart. The distinctive rounded CARTOON CHARACTER CONSTRUCTION is the priority.

selected_styles.name: Painted Storybook
selected_styles.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Style/medium: A sophisticated FULL-BLEED GOUACHE STORYBOOK ILLUSTRATION, with an obvious designed 2D painted shape language. The woman and elderly father are appealing SIMPLIFIED ILLUSTRATED adults, with gently rounded silhouettes, small expressive painted eyes and faces constructed from a few clear color shapes. Paint the indigo jacket, olive cardigan, trousers and hair as large matte color masses with selective visible brush edges; avoid realistic fabric folds or individual hair strands. Hands are simple but legible, the cream envelope is one clear shape. Paint the ENTIRE station and countryside as harmonious broad cream, sage and muted blue color shapes with a few confident dry-brush marks. The hillside should have large designed color patches rather than thousands of tiny trees. Gentle warm daylight appears as broad painted planes, not photometric or airbrushed 3D lighting. Use subtle paper tooth, soft painted edges against a few sharp focal details, calm spacious composition and charming expressive character design. This must read immediately as an ORIGINAL PICTUREBOOK ILLUSTRATION at thumbnail size. No photographic face, naturalistic skin rendering, realistic texture covered with paint, detailed masonry, impasto ridges, dense mottled foliage, anime ink outlines or CGI. It is deliberately stylized, selective and beautifully painted, not a painted-over photograph.
